title.rendered: Architektonická prehliadka budovy Družstevný dom Račan

excerpt.rendered: The former Račan Cooperative Building is arguably the most significant work of postwar modernism in all of Rača. It was designed by Vladimír Dedeček, the architect behind many significant buildings of this period, such as the bridge connecting the Slovak National Gallery and the campus of the University of Agriculture.
